summary: A fortress-like structure featuring a complex central building surrounded by six tall wooden towers. The roofs are flat, made of a dark red material, and topped with glowstone accents. The central building features stone brick banding and a small raised glass section on its roof.

shape.overall_form: central complex surrounded by six distinct towers

materials.name: wood
materials.role: walls of central building and pillars of towers

materials.name: stonebrick
materials.role: banding on central building and vertical accents

materials.name: slab_stone
materials.role: roof edging and ground perimeter markers

materials.name: glass
materials.role: windows in towers and central roof skylight

materials.name: glowstone
materials.role: lighting on top of all roofs

rebuild_hints: Begin by laying out the irregular, complex footprint of the central building.
Erect the six tall wooden towers at their respective positions around the central structure.
Add horizontal stone brick banding to the wooden walls of the central building.
Construct the flat roofs using a dark red block (likely netherrack), ensuring they overhang slightly.
Edge all roofs with stone brick slabs and place a single glowstone block in the center of each.
Add a small raised glass structure in the center of the main building's roof.
uncertainties: Exact dimensions and block counts are estimated.
The specific dark red block used for the roof surface is uncertain; it appears to be netherrack but could be another dark red material.
The interior layout and whether the towers contain multiple functional floors is unknown.
